text: Turkey uses the same licence plates as most of Europe: they are long and white, with a **blue strip** on the left.
text_zh: 土耳其使用的車牌與多數歐洲國家相同：它們是長形白底車牌，左側帶有**藍色條紋**。

text: The Turkish language has a fairly unique look. It uses the following special characters:
- Ç ç and Ş ş with a [cedilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla) (“hook” below the letter).
- Ö ö and Ü ü with an [umlaut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic)) (two dots).
- Ğ ğ with a [breve](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breve).
- Dotless I ı. This letter in particular is noteworthy, as it is essentially unique to Turkish. In case you are confused: this is similar to the letter i, but without a dot when written in lowercase.
- Capital İ with a dot.
text_zh: 土耳其語的外觀相當獨特。它使用下列特殊字元：
-帶有[Cedilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla)（字母下方的「勾」）的 Ç ç 和 Ş ş。
- Ö ö 和 Ü ü，帶有[分音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic))（兩個點）。
- Ğ ğ，帶有[短音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breve)。
- 無點 ı。這個字母特別值得注意，因為它基本上是土耳其語特有的。如果你感到困惑：這類似於字母 i，但在寫成小寫時沒有上面的點。
- 大寫帶點的 İ。

text: Turkish **bollards** have a simple design: rectangular, plain white, and with a red reflector on the front. They are thin when seen from the side.
There is a rare [yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDsyYaBcT9Hpmbpk9) version, seen in some areas with high snowfall.
NOTE: Romania has similar bollards. However, bollards are relatively rare in Romania.
text_zh: 土耳其的**路樁**設計簡單：長方形、純白色，正面有紅色反光片。從側面看很薄。
在某些降雪量大的地區，可以看到罕見的[黃色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/TDsyYaBcT9Hpmbpk9)版本。
注意：羅馬尼亞也有類似的路樁。然而，路樁在羅馬尼亞相對少見。

text: The colour of Turkish road lines is somewhat inconsistent. Most roads simply have white road lines. However, it is not uncommon to see yellow road lines. These roads can have [fully yellow lines](https://goo.gl/maps/NDYQg17SRma1M8VY9), or a [combination of yellow and white lines](https://goo.gl/maps/kVzg32BeNHnxXNhb8).
text_zh: 土耳其的道路標線顏色有些不一致。大多數道路只有白色的道路標線。然而，看到黃色道路標線也並不少見。這些道路可能有[全黃色的標線](https://goo.gl/maps/NDYQg17SRma1M8VY9)，或是[黃白相間的標線](https://goo.gl/maps/kVzg32BeNHnxXNhb8)。

text: Many roads have pavement with a grainy “**salt and pepper**” texture.
text_zh: 許多道路的路面具有帶顆粒感的「**胡椒鹽**」質地。

text: **Divided highways** are extremely common, especially compared to other Mediterranean countries.
text_zh: **分隔高速公路**極為常見，特別是與其他地中海國家相比。

text: Turkish chevrons are typically **red on white**. Beware that there are some other [regional variants](https://goo.gl/maps/c53U4ydsoRYVxGhk9).
Usually, the tip of the arrow does not touch the edge of the chevron. Some chevrons have a [neon yellow border](https://goo.gl/maps/h52NSmYxDJA77zVD8).
text_zh: 土耳其的轉彎標誌通常是**白底紅字**。請注意，也有一些其他的[地區性變體](https://goo.gl/maps/c53U4ydsoRYVxGhk9)。
通常，箭頭的尖端不會觸及轉彎標誌的邊緣。有些轉彎標誌帶有[霓虹黃色邊框](https://goo.gl/maps/h52NSmYxDJA77zVD8)。

text: On intersections, you can often find this distinctive **black and yellow** chevron, with multiple arrows that point upward.
text_zh: 在交叉路口，你經常可以看到這種獨特的**黑黃相間**轉彎標誌，上面有多個向上的箭頭。

text: Sometimes, you can see these **narrow chevrons** that have a red and white colour scheme.

NOTE: Almost identical chevrons can be found in [South Africa](https://www.google.com/maps/@-31.9255787,26.9327084,3a,15y,260.14h,77.09t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1safeEbQeUOh2C-t3z0hfx6Q!2e0!5s20230401T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 有時，你可以看到這些採用紅白配色的**狹窄轉彎標誌**。
注意：在[南非](https://www.google.com/maps/@-31.9255787,26.9327084,3a,15y,260.14h,77.09t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1safeEbQeUOh2C-t3z0hfx6Q!2e0!5s20230401T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)可以找到幾乎一模一樣的轉彎標誌。

text: Direction signs use a very distinct font that can often be recognised by the noticeably **wide letter spaces**.
text_zh: 方向指示牌使用非常獨特的字體，通常可以透過明顯**寬敞的字元間距**來辨識。

text: Snow poles usually feature a colour sequence of black-orange-black-white from top to bottom, with small red reflectors.
text_zh: 雪桿通常從上到下呈現黑-橘-黑-白的顏色順序，並附有小型的紅色反光片。

text: Stop signs have the word “**DUR**” written on them. This is unique to Turkey.
text_zh: 停止標誌上寫著「**DUR**」這個詞。這是土耳其獨有的。

text: Turkey uses both main types of guardrails:
- A-type guardrails, which have **rounded** edges.
- B-type guardrails, which have **square** edges.

While most Mediterranean countries use the A-type, B-type can help solve some tough 50-50s. Furthermore, seeing [both types](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.7634071,36.9889726,3a,75y,279.13h,72.18t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-lWzgc6PumTFgOVCosSYkQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) will exclude all southern European and Middle Eastern countries, other than Montenegro and Israel & the West Bank. For a full overview of which guardrails are found in which European country, see [this infographic](/images/turkey/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 土耳其使用兩種主要類型的護欄：
- A 型護欄，邊緣呈**圓弧狀**。
- B 型護欄，邊緣呈**方形**。

雖然大多數地中海國家使用 A 型，但 B 型可以幫忙解決一些艱難的 50-50 猜題。此外，看到[兩種類型](https://www.google.com/maps/@38.7634071,36.9889726,3a,75y,279.13h,72.18t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-lWzgc6PumTFgOVCosSYkQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)將能排除所有南歐和中東國家，蒙特內哥羅以及以色列和約旦河西岸除外。若要全面了解各個歐洲國家使用哪種護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/turkey/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Metal poles, either in the shape of a **ladder** or with a **mesh** pattern, are extremely common in Turkey.
text_zh: 金屬桿在土耳其極為常見，形狀呈**梯形**或具有**網狀**圖案。

text: In the **Generation 3** coverage, the Google car **never has an antenna**.
text_zh: 在**第 3 代**街景覆蓋中，Google 車**絕不會有天線**。

text: The **Generation 4** coverage in Turkey typically features a **white Google car**. Usually, only a tiny sliver of the back of the car is visible. The car can have a short antenna, or [no antenna](https://goo.gl/maps/cDZNhkcAjdTX5zw89) at all.
text_zh: 土耳其的**第 4 代**街景覆蓋通常配備**白色 Google 車**。通常只能看到車尾的一小截邊緣。這輛車可能裝有短天線，或[完全沒有天線](https://goo.gl/maps/cDZNhkcAjdTX5zw89)。

text: A **grey pickup truck** can be found in some Generation 4 coverage.

NOTE: Similar pickup trucks can also be found in a few other countries. Most relevantly in [Georgia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/x7eAbxAkPQHsJFEZ8) but it is also found in [Senegal](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qVLNzZSjP3uTWXcg8), [Rwanda](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwvwbthLQEbbY1n8), [Kenya](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ggiEBc94DWL7BQwp7), [Ghana ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LN64SQFrKaRJLLoaA)and [Paraguay](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yyuyeus81T3fYH9k8).
text_zh: 在某些 Generation 4 街景覆蓋中可以發現一台**灰色皮卡車**。

注意：類似的皮卡車也出現在其他少數國家。最相關的是在[喬治亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/x7eAbxAkPQHsJFEZ8)，但它也出現在[塞內加爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qVLNzZSjP3uTWXcg8)、[盧安達](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XAwvwbthLQEbbY1n8)、[肯亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ggiEBc94DWL7BQwp7)、[迦納](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LN64SQFrKaRJLLoaA)和[巴拉圭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Yyuyeus81T3fYH9k8)。

text: Turkey also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
text_zh: 土耳其也有 Generation 4 的「小相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般的 Generation 4 更低，並具有一個相對大的圓形模糊區域，前方有一個小突起。模糊區域也可以完全透明，這使得它更難被發現。

text: The Turkish landscape ranges from arid in the [southeast](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A) to a Mediterranean landscape in the [southwest](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7). In the [north](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7) you will often find a more forested and lush landscape. The most typical landscape is semi-arid, either rolling or flat, with vast agricultural fields, containing very limited vegetation other than crops.
Beware that Turkey is a very naturally diverse country with many landscapes that are not mentioned in this tip.
text_zh: 土耳其的地景從[東南部](https://goo.gl/maps/LjNc6hYmCyfbay51A)的乾燥荒漠跨越到[西南部](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzXWMtN6TYYx4GG7)的地中海風貌。在[北部](https://goo.gl/maps/odAj9owBhLGwSmBH7)，你經常會發現森林密布且草木蔥鬱的地景。最具代表性的地景是半乾燥的起伏地形或平原，擁有廣闊的農田，除了農作物之外幾乎沒有什麼植被。
請注意，土耳其是一個自然多樣性極高的國家，有許多本提示未提及的地景。

text: Tall and somewhat square **apartment blocks** are very common in Turkey.
text_zh: 高聳且有點方正的**公寓大樓**在土耳其非常常見。

text: Turkey is a Muslim-majority country, and as such mosques can be found in most towns. In particular, tall [**minarets**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minaret) are extremely common and a good clue for the country.
text_zh: 土耳其是一個以穆斯林為主體的國家，因此大多數城鎮都能找到清真寺。特別是高聳的[**宣禮塔**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minaret)極為常見，是辨識該國的好線索。

text: **Brick pavement** is very common in urban areas, and the bricks will typically have the shape shown in the image.
text_zh: **磚造路面**在市區非常普遍，而且磚塊通常會呈現圖片中所示的形狀。

text: Turkish **area codes** follow a fairly easy to learn pattern and can be very useful to get the general region. Most notably, the first digit of area codes are ordered from 2 in the west to 4 in the east.
NOTE: Phone codes starting with 5 are not regional.
text_zh: 土耳其的**區碼**遵循相當容易學習的規律，對於判斷大略地區非常有用。最值得注意的是，區碼的第一位數字是按照西部為 2 到東部為 4 的順序排列。
注意：以 5 開頭的電話號碼並非地區號碼。

text: Turkey has three main types of numbered roads. The largest type are the [**O-roads**](https://goo.gl/maps/WeocadhrmCAqWDWc6), which on kilometre markers feature an O followed by a hyphen and the road number. The second largest type are the **D-roads**, which omit the “D” on kilometre markers and instead only feature a 3-digit road number, followed by the road section number on the top and the kilometre at the bottom. The section number will generally increase to the southeast.
text_zh: 土耳其有三種主要的編號道路類型。最大的是 [**O-道路**](https://goo.gl/maps/WeocadhrmCAqWDWc6)，其公里標示上會以 O 開頭，接著是連字號和道路編號。第二大類型是 **D-道路**，它們在公里標示上會省略「D」，僅顯示 3 位數的道路編號，上方為道路區段編號，下方為公里數。區段編號通常往東南部遞增。

text: The third type of roads are provincial roads. While these generally aren’t labelled on the map, they can still be used to regionguess since the kilometre markers feature the [**provincial code**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0) as the first two digits on the sign. These codes generally increase alphabetically from 01 to 76 with some newer regions being unordered. Shown in the image is a road from the Afyon Province (03).
text_zh: 第三種道路是省道。雖然這些道路通常不會在地圖上標示，但它們仍然可以用來進行地區猜測，因為公里標示將[**省份代碼**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0)作為標誌上的前兩位數字。這些代碼通常按字母順序從 01 遞增到 76，其中一些較新的地區則沒有順序。圖片中顯示的是來自阿菲永省（03）的一條道路。

text: Generation 4 **truck coverage** is mainly found in the far east of the country and along the southern coast, with smaller pockets in the west and around Kastamonu.
For a more detailed look, see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VJQSEVVZxJHJebLwgQ2aEoS6ML0MENral7g-IiCnRlg/).
text_zh: Generation 4 **卡車街景覆蓋**主要分佈在該國最東部和南部海岸沿線，西部和卡斯塔莫努周邊則有較小的覆蓋範圍。
若要查看更詳細的資訊，請參閱這份[文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VJQSEVVZxJHJebLwgQ2aEoS6ML0MENral7g-IiCnRlg/)。

text: Northern Turkey tends to be significantly **lusher** and **more forested** than the rest of the country.
text_zh: 土耳其北部通常比該國其他地區明顯**更為翠綠**且**森林更茂密**。

text: In the northeast you will find **uncultivated grasslands** in valleys surrounded by round hills. Trees are very limited in the region. In Generation 3 the area has an extremely distinct look, with deep green grass covering the hills. It is significantly more difficult to recognise in Generation 4, where the grass has a more arid look.
text_zh: 在東北部，你會在被圓山環繞的山谷中發現**未開墾的草原**。該地區的樹木非常稀少。在 Generation 3 中，該地區有著極具特色的外觀，深綠色的草覆蓋著群山。在 Generation 4 中要認出它則困難得多，那裡的草看起來更為乾燥。

text: **Turkish pines** ([pinus brutia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia)) are mainly found near the Mediterranean coast.

NOTE: Turkish pines can appear very similar to [Aleppo pines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_halepensis), which are uncommon in Turkey, but are often found in [other Mediterranean countries](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.0385689,0.4753459,3a,48.5y,144.08h,92.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shQfy4LKJz9mGqNx8fa89MA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **土耳其松** ([pinus brutia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia)) 主要分佈在地中海沿岸附近。

注意：土耳其松看起來可能與[阿勒頗松](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_halepensis)非常相似，後者在土耳其不常見，但經常出現在[其他地中海國家](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.0385689,0.4753459,3a,48.5y,144.08h,92.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1shQfy4LKJz9mGqNx8fa89MA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: **Tea plantations** are common in the province of Rize.
text_zh: **茶園**在里澤省非常普遍。

text: **Olive trees** are mainly found on the Mediterranean coast.
text_zh: **橄欖樹**主要分佈在地中海沿岸。

text: **Sunflowers** are mainly found in northwestern Turkey.
text_zh: **向日葵**主要分佈在土耳其西北部。

text: A majority of all **vineyards** in Turkey can be found in a region east of Izmir.
text_zh: 土耳其絕大多數的 **葡萄園** 都位於伊茲密爾以東的地區。

text: **Cotton** is mainly found in the region surrounding the city of Şanlıurfa.
text_zh: **棉花**主要分佈在尚勒烏爾法市周邊地區。

text: Lake Van is by far the biggest lake in Turkey and has a semi-arid landscape, being surrounded by dry grassy hills and occasional trees and [agricultural fields](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7) near the shore.
text_zh: 凡湖是土耳其最大的湖泊，擁有半乾旱景觀，岸邊環繞著乾燥的草地山丘、零星的樹木以及[農田](https://goo.gl/maps/LCwckUWMg8zV8yrX7)。

text: Dark, **volcanic rocks** are commonly found between the cities of Şanlıurfa and Diyarbakır.
text_zh: 深色的 **火山岩** 常見於尚勒烏爾法與迪亞巴克爾兩市之間。

text: River valleys surrounded by steep, **barren and rocky cliff sides** can be found between the cities of Erzurum and Artvin and in the [southeast](https://goo.gl/maps/zDhSPCWVAnGq3Ms18) near the city of Hakkâri.
text_zh: 被陡峭、**貧瘠且多石的懸崖** 環繞的河谷，分佈在埃爾祖魯姆與阿爾特溫兩市之間，以及[東南部](https://goo.gl/maps/zDhSPCWVAnGq3Ms18)哈卡里市附近。

text: **Tiled roofs** are mostly found in the western two thirds of the country.
Note that for this and the following roof-related tips to be reliable, the majority of all visible roofs should preferably be of that type.
text_zh: **瓦片屋頂** 主要分佈在該國西部三分之二的地區。
請注意，為了讓這個以及接下來與屋頂相關的提示準確可靠，所有可見屋頂中的大多數最好都屬於該類型。

text: **Flat roofs** are mostly found in the southeast and to a lesser extent along the south coast.
text_zh: **平屋頂** 主要分佈在東南部，南海岸一帶則較少見。

text: **Metal roofs** are most common in the east.
text_zh: **金屬屋頂** 在東部最為常見。

text: Sheet metal roofs shaped like **low pyramids** are mainly found far east, particularly in the general area surrounding Lake Van.
text_zh: 形似 **低矮金字塔** 的鐵皮屋頂主要分佈在極東地區，特別是凡湖周邊的廣大區域。

text: Many buildings in the Nevşehir Province are built by large, light and unevenly coloured, **sandstone bricks**.
text_zh: 內夫謝爾省的許多建築都是用大型、淺色且顏色不均的 **砂岩磚** 所建造。

text: **Yellow on black chevrons** are mainly found in and around the Balıkesir Province in the west and in the [Kars Province](https://www.google.com/maps/@40.7194663,43.1857553,3a,15y,58.93h,86.15t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1scyws6VGByT2Y02WeHnA4dw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) in the far east. Beware that you may very rarely find them [elsewhere](https://goo.gl/maps/bQYsRcd5eqHj3x1h7).
text_zh: **黃底黑字轉彎標誌** 主要分佈在西部的巴勒克西爾省境內及周邊，以及極東的[卡爾斯省](https://www.google.com/maps/@40.7194663,43.1857553,3a,15y,58.93h,86.15t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1scyws6VGByT2Y02WeHnA4dw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。請注意，你在[其他地方](https://goo.gl/maps/bQYsRcd5eqHj3x1h7)極少數情況下也可能找到它們。

text: **Black on yellow chevrons** are mainly found north of Izmir.
text_zh: **黑底黃字轉彎標誌** 主要分佈在伊茲密爾以北。

text: Four-lane divided highways with **no divider**, other than double middle road lines, are almost exclusively found in the eastern half of the country.
Beware that divided highways with [clear dividers](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9), such as guardrails, can still be found in the east.
text_zh: 雙向四車道且 **沒有分隔島**（僅有雙黃線道路標線）的分隔公路，幾乎只分佈在該國的東半部。
請注意，在東部仍然可以找到帶有[清晰分隔設施](https://goo.gl/maps/SLzhkGpReMShmtDt9)（例如護欄）的分隔公路。

text: **Vertical water tanks** can be found in most of Turkey, but are notably uncommon along the south and west coast.
text_zh: **直立式水塔** 幾乎遍佈整個土耳其，但在南海岸與西海岸明顯較少見。

text: Horizontal water tanks placed **on top of** vertical water tanks are primarily found in a line following the south coast and going up to Elâzığ.
text_zh: 放置在直立式水塔 **上方** 的橫向水塔，主要分佈在沿著南海岸延伸至埃拉澤的線路上。

text: **Square water tanks** with angled corners are found in the south, approximately from İskenderun to Sanliurfa.
text_zh: 帶有夾角的 **方形水塔** 分佈在南部，大約從伊斯肯德倫延伸至尚勒烏爾法。

text: White **spherical water tanks** can be found in the southeast, mainly south of Batman.
text_zh: 白色 **球形水塔** 可在東南部找到，主要分佈在巴特曼以南。

text: In the European part of Turkey, except Istanbul, utility poles, and other electrical infrastructure, will have a 6 digit code, which is often seen on a small pole plate under the yellow electricity warning plate.
text_zh: 在土耳其的歐洲部分（伊斯坦堡除外），電線桿和其他電力基礎設施會有一個 6 位數的編號，通常可以在黃色電力警告牌下方的金屬小牌上看到。

text: Street signs in the Ankara Province are blue with a small **round top**. Similar street signs can very rarely be found in [Giresun](https://goo.gl/maps/aVtMnDJsqJ1ms4jf6).

Beware that some [newer street signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9941773,32.8704415,3a,15y,27.52h,88.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sHNDiTJyKaZv36GFlgPI6wg!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) are red.
text_zh: 安卡拉省的街道標誌是藍色的，頂端帶有小 **圓頭**。[吉雷松](https://goo.gl/maps/aVtMnDJsqJ1ms4jf6)極少數情況下也能找到類似的街道標誌。
請注意，有些[較新的街道標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@39.9941773,32.8704415,3a,15y,27.52h,88.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sHNDiTJyKaZv36GFlgPI6wg!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)是紅色的。

text: Street signs in the Izmir Province are dark blue, noticeably **bulge outwards** and very commonly have the **emblem** of Izmir in white at the top of the sign.
text_zh: 伊茲密爾省的街道標誌為深藍色，明顯 **向外凸出**，且標誌頂端通常印有白色的伊茲密爾 **徽章**。

text: If you find yourself surrounded by **greenhouses**, you are likely to be along the south coast west of Adana.
text_zh: 如果你發現自己被 **溫室** 環繞，你很可能位於阿達納以西的南海岸一帶。

text: Around the city of Bodrum you will commonly find this type of **whitewashed buildings** with flat roofs, often combined with [blue details](https://goo.gl/maps/jcmMEtAFzgkLEf466) or [unpainted stone walls](https://goo.gl/maps/GvWo5wWdFEorZkaP8).
text_zh: 在博德魯姆市周邊，通常會看到這種帶有平屋頂的 **白牆建築**，常搭配[藍色細節](https://goo.gl/maps/jcmMEtAFzgkLEf466)或[未刷漆的石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/GvWo5wWdFEorZkaP8)。

text: Göreme, west of Kayseri, can be recognised by the tall **sandstone monoliths** with ancient dwellings carved into them.
text_zh: 開薩利以西的格雷梅，其特徵是高聳的 **砂岩巨石**，上面雕刻著古代的居所。

text: [Mount Ararat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ararat), labelled as Ağrı Dağı on Google Maps, is a dormant volcano in far eastern Turkey and the **tallest mountain** in the country. It is often seen together with Küçük Ağrı, a smaller volcano to the southeast.
text_zh: [亞拉拉山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ararat)在 Google 地圖上標記為 Ağrı Dağı，是土耳其極東部的一座休眠火山，也是該國 **最高山峰**。它經常與東南較小的火山小亞拉拉山一同出現。

text: **Banana plants** are found around the city of Alanya.
text_zh: **香蕉樹** 分佈在阿拉尼亚市周邊。

text: Road E99 south of Şanlıurfa is a divided highway which can be recognised by the slightly hazy Generation 4 sunrise coverage combined with the flat agricultural landscape and general south-north road angle.
text_zh: 尚勒烏爾法以南的 E99 公路是一條分隔公路，其特徵是帶有微霧的第四代日出街景覆蓋，結合平坦的農業景觀以及大致呈南北走向的道路角度。

text: Road D525 south of Söke is a completely straight road going south-south-west to north-north-east with winter Generation 3 coverage. Along the road you will typically find a large amount of reed.
text_zh: 索凱以南的 D525 公路是一條筆直的道路，呈南南西至北北東走向，帶有第三代冬季街景覆蓋。沿著道路通常可以找到大量的蘆薈。

text: Along the western shore of Lake Beyşehir and [Lake Eğirdir](https://goo.gl/maps/9R4Hc6UMzMLLTn7g6) you can find this small single lane road with jagged, exposed rock and [Turkish pines](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia) to the west. These two can be differentiated by the road west of Lake Eğirdir having a middle road line.
text_zh: 沿着貝伊謝爾湖與[埃吉爾代湖](https://goo.gl/maps/9R4Hc6UMzMLLTn7g6)的西岸，你可以找到這條狹窄的單線道路，西側有崎嶇裸露的岩石和[土耳其赤松](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinus_brutia)。這兩處的區別在於埃吉爾代湖西側的道路擁有道路中線。

text: These light blue and grey **touristic signs** which are either arrow shaped or rectangular with a half circle on the top can be found on the island of Bozcaada.
text_zh: 這些淺藍與灰色的 **觀光標誌**（呈箭頭狀或上方帶半圓形的長方形）可以在博茲賈島上找到。

text: Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip are found in several cities. In the bottom right corner, you can find a white arrow and some numbers. If this arrow is pointing in **both directions** and has a **single arrowhead**, rather than [double](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7), then you are almost certainly in Istanbul.

Beware that simple arrows pointing in only one direction can be found in both [Istanbul](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9) and in [other cities](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8). However, if you see such signs in combination with [red house numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA), then you should be in Istanbul.
text_zh: 帶有彩色底條的紅色街道標誌可在多個城市找到。在右下角，你會看到一個白色箭頭和一些數字。如果這個箭頭指向 **雙向** 且只有 **單側箭頭**，而非[雙側箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7)，那麼你幾乎可以確定身處伊斯坦堡。
請注意，只指向單一方向的簡單箭頭既可在[伊斯坦堡](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9)找到，也可在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8)找到。然而，如果你看到此類標誌搭配[紅色門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA)，那你應該就在伊斯坦堡。

text: Street signs in Trabzon and [Yalvaç](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9) are **red** and **oval-shaped**. [House numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A) also feature the same design.
text_zh: 特拉布宗與[亞爾瓦奇](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9)的街道標誌為 **紅色** 且呈 **橢圓形**。[門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A)也採用相同的設計。

text: Street signs in Bursa are **green**, and generally have slightly **extruded letters**, meaning the signs are not completely flat.
NOTE: Several other types of infrastructure in Bursa, such as [fences](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7) and [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8), may also be coloured green.
text_zh: 布爾薩的街道標誌為 **綠色**，且通常帶有微幅 **凸出的字體**，這意味著標誌並非完全平坦。
註：布爾薩的其他幾種基礎設施（例如[圍欄](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7)與[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8)）也可能漆成綠色。

text: Street signs in Bolu are also **green**, but are **completely flat** and lack any kind of border.
text_zh: 博盧的街道標誌也是 **綠色**，但 **完全平坦** 且沒有任何邊框。
